android.desc:
Stay updated with the news that matters to you with Your News. You are in full control of your content, including RSS feeds, YouTube channels, and Reddit posts. Read updates directly in the app or continue from your home screen with customizable RSS widgets. Enjoy the best content without distractions—only the news you care about, all in one place.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Your News stores all your data locally on your device. No sign-up, no cloud, no hassle. It is all yours and private, making it the perfect private news reader app.

ADD FEEDS EASILY
Quickly add your favorite RSS feeds, YouTube channels, or Reddit feeds with dedicated buttons, making it simple to tailor your personalized news aggregator experience.

DISCOVER NEW FEEDS
New to RSS feeds or looking for fresh sources? Use the search function to find feeds by website name or explore new content in the Discover section.

RSS WIDGETS
Read news from your home screen with customizable, scrollable RSS widgets.

CUSTOM KEYWORD FILTERS
Stay focused only on the content that interests you by applying custom keyword filters to show or hide articles based on specific topics or keywords.

MULTIPLE READING MODES
Read your news seamlessly within the app, watch YouTube videos directly with the in-app player, and access Reddit posts without switching apps. Get everything in one place!

DARK MODE
Enjoy reading even at night with dark mode for a comfortable, low-light experience, making it easier on your eyes while reading.

OPML IMPORT/EXPORT
Switching from another RSS reader app? Easily import your feeds with an OPML file and pick up right where you left off, with no hassle.

BACKUP YOUR SETTINGS
Switching phones? Do not worry. Back up your settings and easily restore them on your new device, so you never lose your preferences.

SEND FEEDBACK
Your feedback is important. Share your thoughts directly with the built-in feedback system to help improve the app. Your input helps make Your News even better.

Get started with Your News today and enjoy the most personalized, private, and convenient news reading experience!

quotes.text:
Hello everyone!

Your News is a personalized RSS Feed reader that helps you only consume the news you want to see.

Currently, Your News has the following functionalities:

- Dedicated buttons to add YouTube and RSS feeds.
- Search for RSS feeds using the feedsearch.dev API.
- Categorizing RSS feeds.
- OPML Import.
- Mark as favorite/read later.
- Keyword filters.
- Dark Mode.
- YouTube video player without ads.

I want to add more features in the upcoming versions, like widgets and notifications. In the future, the application will also be available on iOS, the web, and desktop.

I hope the application can help you stay up-to-date with your news. Have a good one!
